recipe.name: Ilex / Delft clay / Gold 18k
recipe.calibration_note: Starting values; verify with shop trials

manufacturing.bench_notes: Factory 006 through the sand master, z = 0 parting, opposed z withdrawal. Every leaf on the face and shoulders lies on the parting line with its midrib on it; the cheek leaves stand along the pull. After the pour: cut the vein combs, drill each garnet seat on its raised mark, cut it to the measured stone and burnish flush. Polish the field and the palm; leave the veins satin.
